items.title: CVE-2026-114938: Critical vulnerability in OpenJDK JAVA
items.excerpt: Cisco Talos is tracking the disclosure of a critical vulnerability in OpenJDK Java (CVE-2026-114938), dubbed “Java4Shell,” with a CVSS 4.0 score of 9.2 that may lead to unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE).

items.title: GTIG AI Threat Tracker: Agentic Threat Activity Crosses a Significant Threshold
items.excerpt: Written by: Aurora Blum, Kelli Vanderlee, Jess Xia, David Mainor Executive Summary As threat actors increasingly move beyond basic prompting to deploying autonomous multi-agent frameworks , automated vulnerability exploitation pipelines, and alternative monetization schemes like LLMJacking , the adversarial AI landscape has reached a critical inflection point. In this update, Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) and Mandiant examine how adversaries across the cyber crime, espionage, and information operations spectrum are operationalizing generative AI to compress attack timelines, scale operations, and execute multi-stage intrusions at machine speed. Key trends over the last quarter include: Shift to Autonomous Workflows and Multi-Agent Frameworks: Adversary tradecraft has continued to transition beyond manual prompting to deploying autonomous multi-agent offensive frameworks—such as ARTEX , CAIRN, CyberStrikeAI, and PentAGI—to execute multi-stage intrusions at greater operational velocity. items.title: COLD RELIC: A Case Study in Impersonation and Compromise
items.excerpt: Written by: Josh Murchie, John Wolfram, Joseph Spero, Peter Ukhanov, Fernando Tomlinson, Jr., Wesley Shields Introduction Over the past year, Mandiant has responded to a series of linked intrusions demonstrating how Russian cyber espionage group COLD RELIC (formerly tracked as COLDRIVER and UNC4057; also known as Star Blizzard, Callisto, and Gossamer Bear) turns a single cloud compromise into a springboard for ongoing third party compromise and espionage. Most recently, Mandiant investigated a 2026 compromise at a US-based organization where COLD RELIC directly weaponized data, the corporate staff directory, and identities stolen during a late-2025 compromise, which Mandiant also investigated, at a separate US-based organization. COLD RELIC is a Russian state-sponsored threat group that the US Department of Justice (DOJ) has assessed operates within Russia's Federal Security Service (FSB). items.title: Huntress Delivers 24/7 Response for Microsoft Defender Incidents Across Endpoints and Microsoft 365
items.excerpt: The Huntress Agentic Security Platform now sees incidents from Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365, Defender for Cloud Apps, and Entra ID Protection. The new data already helped uncover a token-replay campaign that hit 97 accounts at 79 organizations.
